card.name: Digits and decimal points inside numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a multi-digit number, mostly right after a leading 1, 0 or 3 (as in 1.5, 0.25, 3.7). It appears in doses, percentages and counters.

modes.label: Decimal point after 1
modes.description: The period in a number such as 1.5 or 1.6, in dose or lab-threshold text.

modes.label: Digit after a decimal point
modes.description: The digit right after the decimal point in a small dose or concentration.

modes.label: Digit in a long number
modes.description: A digit inside a long ID, hash or counter number.
